sources.title: Diagonal Periods and Newton Supports of Rules 30, 86 and 135
sources.author: Tigran Nersissian
sources.scope_read: Coordinates and Newton OR-convolution; diagonal period and center-column limitations
sources.relevance: Uses the same Newton subset representation and OR-convolution. Its diagonal period conclusions do not prove a uniform canonical observer or fixed-center nonperiodicity. The reflected reset argument is another diagonal system.

sources.title: Analysis of Pseudo Random Sequences Generated by Cellular Automata
sources.scope_read: Publisher abstract only; full paper not available through this access
sources.relevance: Cryptanalytic key search from temporal observations is not the all-width canonical white-boundary observer. No injectivity theorem inferred from the abstract.

sources.title: Inversion of Cellular Automata Iterations
sources.authors: C. K. Koc and A. M. Apohan
sources.relevance: Studies predecessor recovery for finite circular automata and affine approximations. It supplies no exact uniform cubic observer for the canonical sheared system.

sources.title: Analyse des suites aleatoires engendrees par des automates cellulaires et applications a la cryptographie
sources.author: Bruno Martin
sources.scope_read: Finite-ring model and temporal-sequence reconstruction discussion
sources.relevance: The boundary and observation convention differ from the current fixed-clock white profile graph. No unverified result used as a lemma.
